job.job_description:
Role- Python AI or Python Fullstack Engineer

Designation- Senior/Lead Developer

Exp- 5 to 15Year

Location- Gurgaon, Pune, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Coimbatore, Jaipur




JD-

Python AI-

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI-powered applications using Python and modern Generative AI frameworks.
Build and deploy single-agent and multi-agent AI systems for enterprise use cases.
Develop scalable RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using vector databases and LLMs.
Build REST APIs and backend services using FastAPI.
Integrate AI applications with external tools, APIs, databases, and enterprise systems.
Optimize LLM performance through prompt engineering, evaluation, monitoring, and observability.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, scalable, and production-ready AI solutions.
Follow best practices for testing, deployment, security, and Responsible AI.

Required Skills

5+ years of software development experience with strong proficiency in Python.
Hands-on experience with LangGraph, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, or similar agentic AI frameworks.
Strong understanding of LLMs, prompt engineering, tool calling, memory, and multi-agent orchestration.
Experience building RAG applications using vector databases such as Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, or Qdrant.
Hands-on experience with FastAPI and REST API development.
Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent communication frameworks.
Experience with Git, Docker, CI/CD, and production deployment.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.




Python Fullstack-




Required Technical Experience

Backend Development (5+ years) Mandatory

Python backend development
Flask framework for API development
Pandas for data manipulation and analysis

Frontend Development – Mandatory

Angular/React framework (TypeScript, component architecture, state management)

Database Technologies – Mandatory

SQL databases (design, query optimization, transactions)
MongoDB (document modeling, aggregation pipelines, indexing)

Cloud & DevOps – Nice to Have

Good general knowledge of cloud computing concepts
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (preferred)
Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and containerization (Docker)
SOLID principles and microservices architecture
DevOps practices (automated testing, monitoring)

Key Responsibilities

Design and implement scalable, business features and functionality for backend systems
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product owners, designers, QA, and DevOps
Write clean, maintainable code using industry best practices and modern programming languages
Ensure application performance, security, and scalability
Perform code reviews and contribute to best development practices
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve production issues
Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies and sprint planning
Testing and Debugging: Ability to write unit tests, perform debugging, and ensure clean, maintainable code adhering to industry best practices
Document workflows, processes, and technical specifications to support technical clarity and continuity
Stay updated on emerging trends and technologies, integrating them where appropriate

Provide post-deployment support to address user feedback and system improvements
